faq.question: Is disinfection the same as cleaning?
faq.answer: No. Cleaning removes dirt and most germs; disinfection kills remaining microorganisms on a surface that is already clean. Both are needed, in that order.

faq.question: Are the products safe for people and pets?
faq.answer: We use authorised products according to their instructions and ventilate the area. We tell you when the space can be used again.

faq.question: Do you offer fogging or misting?
faq.answer: We favour targeted manual disinfection, which is more reliable on high-contact surfaces. Other methods can be discussed for specific situations.
